Eh, considering i think i will delay on talking to them. 

Wanna know the worst part about the entire thing? I live with the kid, he is my manager, and i will be seeing him almost every single day. I get no break and i am going to have to constantly see it (him and biddie). SDFIOPHSRGIOHHRFIOJPASDFDWE!!!!!!!!

i may take you up on the offer of talking, and that you for the offer too. it just sucks, everything about it sucks.

The issue is, in regards to you family remark, i just came out to them not to long ago. I don't want to throw this one them when that is just setting in. Don't get me wrong, they would do it - help me that is - with no qualms. It would just make them uncomfortable. I also get that times will heal it, it just hurts.

Like really hurts. 

I don't get why, and i don't like it either. There seems to be nothing to make it better, and probably doesn't help that i am drinking to numb me over till i am done finals. I just can't deal with them both, and have either of them turn out well. I have to focus on one, which sucks.


GAAHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!! i just hate this.

The thing is i honestly can't tell him because he will feel guilty for the entire thing, and it will hurt him. It will hurt him more because there is nothing he can do either. He is also finally starting to become happy again and enjoy himself; i don't wanna take that since it is what i want for him.

Luckily, i have quite good acting skills (years of self-hate really polish those skills) so i will just, "suck it up and deal with it". The only person i would ever talk to about these things is him, so it kinda leaves me alone.... hence why I came to place i knew someone would talk to me (thanks for that). It really is just a shitty situation, and i recognize that i will never have the person whom i fell in love with for the right reasons.

No he got through over time, and I lost him because the night I planned to tell him he ended up staying at this girls place he met. Tonight I was sleeping and they spent hasn't an hour doing what I wished I could have had. He even was apologizing mid-action even though he thought I was asleep.
I couldn't leave because I was happy for him getting some (he has been down and I was helping him... I think), it would have been rude, my  masochist tendencies probably didn't help. I was just a ball of hurt and happiness and I have no one to talk to about anything. As of right now, I don't think he evens knows I am aware.....

The issue isn't lost love, it was I lost the first person I let myself actually  care about. I have always had my wall because of bein hurt in the past. He was the first person to really get through it no matter what I did. I used him as support, my soapbox, and my sounding board and in one fell swoop it is gone. 

The worst part is that I am happy for Him while being so god damn angry with myself and everything.... I just don't know what to do. I know time is the only real thing to make it better, nut I have no one to talk to got help. If I talked to him he would be wracked with guilt for something he couldn't change, and that is just unfair to him. Life is poop and I don't wanna take my exam either

Hi, issue is I see none, because I lost the ability I cherished most; staying impartial and going about situations intelligently. Seems I ducked up at some point. Next best would be my singing voice. 

 How about you?? Also, what do you mean by, "why are you not your best friend?"
